text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your sympathy. You know that 
already, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I was told I did terribly today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course I wouldn't be able to come in 
first with running like this...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I didn't want to realize it either! 
It's just like she said!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
As I am now, I can't leave anything 
behind! I'm just... completely empty...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainerrr...! What am I supposed to 
do...?!"

—Having crossed the stage of the Oaks, 
Daiwa Scarlet now laid her honest feelings 
bare.

Reflecting on her own running, while 
trying to understand what she lacked.

"...If it's right now, perhaps I can make 
her and 'that girl' face each other."
